reason: A terminal-first user interface and bundle for DeepSeek Harness agents, with session management, tool approvals, planning and goal workflows, local shell mode, file mentions, and configurable model providers.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供全屏终端界面，支持会话管理、工具审批、计划与目标工作流、模型配置及本地 Shell 模式。
summaries.en: A full-screen terminal interface for DeepSeek Harness agents with session management, tool approvals, planning and goal workflows, model configuration, and local shell mode.

capabilities: Provides a full-screen terminal interface for interacting with a DeepSeek Harness agent
Sends follow-up and steering messages to agent sessions and resumes persisted sessions
Runs local shell commands through shell mode
Displays and manages agent tools, plans, goals, context, sessions, and approvals
Supports switching and editing LLM provider profiles, including API key configuration
Can operate with configurable permission presets including workspace-write and danger-full-access
Performs a best-effort npm registry update check
